title: Verify calculate premium returns 201 with complete pricing response

steps.action: Submit a valid calculate request using parameterized policy, coverage, product, jurisdiction, transaction type, effective date, and pricing inputs.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created and includes result_id, policy_id, coverage_code, product_code, jurisdiction_code, transaction_type, effective_date, base_premium, total_modifiers, total_fees, final_premium, calculation_version, line_items, and created_at.

title: Verify base premium equals sum of RATE_ base premium line items

steps.action: Submit calculate request and sum all line_items where item_type=BasePremium or rule_code starts with RATE_.
steps.expected: Response base_premium equals the summed RATE_ line item amounts with decimal precision maintained.

title: Verify rule code prefixes map to correct pricing line item types

steps.action: Submit calculate request that triggers multiple pricing rule prefixes and inspect line_items.
steps.expected: Each line item has the correct item_type based on rule_code prefix; unmapped or incorrect item type is not returned.

title: Verify modifiers are applied in ascending sequence_order

steps.action: Submit calculate request and verify Modifier/Discount/Surcharge line items are ordered by sequence_order.
steps.expected: Modifier-related line_items are returned/applied in ascending sequence_order and final_premium reflects that order.

title: Verify identical inputs produce deterministic premium result and line item order

steps.action: Send two calculate requests with identical inputs and compare final_premium, base_premium, total_modifiers, total_fees, and sequence_order values.
steps.expected: Both responses have identical premium totals and identical ordering of applied pricing line items.

title: Verify final premium formula uses base premium, net modifier effect, fees, and taxes

steps.action: Submit calculate request and independently compute expected final premium from response line items.
steps.expected: Response final_premium equals calculated value from base_premium, total_modifiers/net modifier effect, and total_fees within allowed decimal precision.

title: Verify fees and taxes are added after modifier application

steps.action: Submit calculate request and compare total_fees with sum of Fee and Tax line items.
steps.expected: total_fees equals sum of FEE_ and TAX_ line item amounts and final_premium adds total_fees after modifier calculation.

title: Verify decimal precision is maintained for all monetary values

steps.action: Submit calculate request and validate amount fields, base_premium, total_modifiers, total_fees, and final_premium precision.
steps.expected: All monetary fields preserve expected decimal precision and no binary floating point drift is visible.

title: Verify calculate supports Quote transaction type

steps.action: Submit calculate request with transaction_type=Quote.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created and transaction_type in response is Quote.

title: Verify calculate supports Endorsement transaction type

steps.action: Submit calculate request with transaction_type=Endorsement.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created and transaction_type in response is Endorsement.

title: Verify calculate supports Issuance transaction type

steps.action: Submit calculate request with transaction_type=Issuance.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created and transaction_type in response is Issuance.

title: Verify calculate supports Renewal transaction type

steps.action: Submit calculate request with transaction_type=Renewal.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created and transaction_type in response is Renewal.

title: Verify recalculate creates new result and supersedes prior result

steps.action: Create initial result, then submit recalculate for the same policy and coverage.
steps.expected: Recalculate response is 201 Created with a new result_id; prior result is marked is_superseded=true and superseded_by_id points to new result.

title: Verify recalculate behaves like calculate when no prior result exists

steps.action: Submit recalculate request for a policy/coverage with no existing result.
steps.expected: Response is 201 Created, is_superseded=false, and no prior result update is required.

title: Verify full pricing history includes superseded and current results

steps.action: After calculate and recalculate, call GET results by policy.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and includes both superseded and non-superseded results for the policy.

title: Verify latest endpoint returns only most recent non-superseded result

steps.action: After multiple calculations/recalculations for same policy and coverage, call latest endpoint.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and returns a single non-superseded result with latest result_id.

title: Verify trace endpoint returns complete audit trace for calculated result

steps.action: Call trace endpoint for a valid result_id created by calculate.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and contains original inputs, output snapshot, applied rule codes, execution time, and calculation metadata.

title: Verify trace remains accessible for superseded result

steps.action: After recalculate supersedes an earlier result, call trace endpoint using the superseded result_id.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK; trace for superseded result is retained and accessible.

title: Verify unknown policy returns 200 with empty result array

steps.action: Call GET results using a tenant-scoped policy_id that has no pricing results.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and body is an empty array [].

title: Verify unknown result trace returns 404

steps.action: Call trace endpoint with a valid-format but non-existing result_id.
steps.expected: Response is 404 Not Found with trace/result not found problem detail.

title: Verify missing policy_id returns 400

steps.action: Submit calculate request without policy_id.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request and validation error identifies policy_id.

title: Verify policy_id exceeding maximum length returns 400

steps.action: Submit calculate request with policy_id length greater than 200.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request and validation error identifies policy_id max length.

title: Verify missing coverage_code returns 400

steps.action: Submit calculate request without coverage_code.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request and validation error identifies coverage_code.

title: Verify invalid transaction_type returns 400

steps.action: Submit calculate request with invalid transaction_type.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request and validation error identifies transaction_type.

title: Verify missing effective_date returns 400

steps.action: Submit calculate request with missing or default effective_date.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request and validation error identifies effective_date.

title: Verify null pricing_inputs returns 400

steps.action: Submit calculate request with pricing_inputs=null.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request and validation error identifies pricing_inputs.

title: Verify calculate without bearer token returns 401

steps.action: Submit calculate request without Authorization header.
steps.expected: Response is 401 Unauthorized.

title: Verify monitor-only token cannot calculate or recalculate

steps.action: Submit calculate or recalculate request using a read/monitor-only token.
steps.expected: Response is 403 Forbidden and no pricing result is created.

title: Verify tenant isolation for pricing result retrieval

steps.action: Create a pricing result under Tenant A, then attempt to retrieve the same policy_id using Tenant B token.
steps.expected: Response does not expose Tenant A results; expected body is empty array or not found according to API tenant-isolation contract.

title: Verify rate limit exceeded returns 429 for calculate endpoint

steps.action: Submit calculate requests above configured rate-limit window.
steps.expected: Response is 429 Too Many Requests after configured threshold is exceeded and no duplicate result should be relied on.
